up: Find all compounds reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL3833082. Return the compound ChEMBL ID (compound_chembl_id), preferred name (compound_name), and canonical SMILES. Join the docs table (filtered by chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3833082') to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and left join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles. Apply DISTINCT to ensure each compound is listed only once. Do not apply any ranking or row limits.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, md.pref_name AS compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3833082'
